surveillance.plainEng: Teaches cameras to catch problems on factory floors instantly — no human needed
surveillance.meta: Solo · Ongoing · YOLO + classical CV pipeline
surveillance.codePeek:
# Core detection loop
results = model(frame)
for box in results[0].boxes:
    conf = float(box.conf)
    if conf > THRESHOLD:
        cls = int(box.cls)
        alert(cls, conf, frame)
highlights: Real-time YOLO inference at the edge — no cloud dependency
Classical CV preprocessing significantly cuts false-positive rate
Modular design: swap detection heads per deployment context
Targeting Jetson AGX Xavier for production-grade throughput

night-vision.plainEng: Lets robots see in pitch darkness and autonomously patrol perimeters on battery power
night-vision.meta: Team · B.E. capstone · Embedded · Raspberry Pi
night-vision.codePeek:
# Night-vision preprocessing
gray = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
eq = cv2.equalizeHist(gray)
edges = cv2.Canny(eq, 50, 150)
motion = detect_motion(prev, eq)
highlights: IR camera integration with OpenCV night-vision preprocessing pipeline
Motion-triggered alerts with configurable detection zone polygons
Edge-deployed on Raspberry Pi — battery-powered, zero cloud dependency
Mounted on unmanned ground vehicle for fully autonomous perimeter patrol
